abstract: Ovarian germ cell cancers are rare malignancies accounting for less than 5% of all ovarian cancers. We present a family in which three closely related women were diagnosed with ovarian germ cell malignancies. This family's cancer history prompted a family history investigation of women treated for ovarian germ cell malignancies in the Gynecologic-Oncology Clinic at the University of Wisconsin. One of the eight patients whose family histories were reviewed had an uncle who had been diagnosed with testicular germ cell cancer. A review found six other previously reported families in which more than one relative had been diagnosed with a malignant ovarian germ cell tumor. Additionally, several cases of families with both males and females diagnosed with germ cell cancers have been documented. The low incidence of ovarian germ cell cancers suggests that multiple occurrences in the same family may not be due to chance. Rather, it is possible that a gene conferring susceptibility to ovarian germ cell cancers, and possibly to germ cell tumors in males as well, is present in at least some of these families.
abstract_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍は稀な悪性腫瘍であり、全卵巣癌の5％未満を占める。我々は、近縁の3人の女性が卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍と診断された家族を報告する。この家族のがん歴から、ウィスコンシン大学婦人科腫瘍外来で卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療を受けた女性の家族歴を調査した。家族歴を調べた8例の患者のうち1例は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された叔父がいた。文献レビューでは、同一家系内で複数の親族が悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された他の6家系が見つかった。さらに、男性と女性の両方が胚細胞腫瘍と診断された家族も複数報告されている。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生頻度は低いため、同一家系内での複数発症は偶然によるものではない可能性がある。むしろ、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍、そして場合によっては精巣胚細胞腫瘍にも感受性を与える遺伝子が、一部の家族に存在する可能性がある。
